name: Kendall K1 navigation timekeeper
summary: Larcum Kendall's K1, a copy of Harrison's H4, carried on Cook's second Pacific voyage and used to determine longitude, showing the design could be reproduced.
description: Kendall’s K1 copy of Harrison’s H4 watch, used as a marine reference timekeeper.
tier_reason: A bounded technical contribution, transmission episode or documented configuration useful within a specific history; no broad dependence claim is established.

impact.note: One copy of a known watch showed the design could be reproduced and had a few successors, which scores just below the reviewed tier 2.

why: The Board of Longitude wanted to know whether Harrison's watch could be copied by another maker and perform at sea.

places.note: HMS Resolution, Cook’s second voyage (Pacific and Southern Oceans)
